items.title: Astera Labs Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: Q4 2025 revenue grew 17% sequentially to a record $270.6 million; the company also disclosed Q1 2026 revenue guidance of $286 million to $297 million.

items.title: alab-20251231 (SEC 10-K)
items.snippet: Risk factors cite possible reduced demand from weak or volatile economic conditions, supply chain disruptions, trade sanctions, export restrictions, tariffs, and other external events.
